maddeler.e:
اصطحبت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَحَبْتُ (iṣṭaḥabtu) /isˤ.tˤa.ħab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# اِصْطَحَبْتَ (iṣṭaḥabta) /isˤ.tˤa.ħab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# اِصْطَحَبْتِ (iṣṭaḥabti) /isˤ.tˤa.ħab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# اِصْطَحَبَتْ (iṣṭaḥabat) /isˤ.tˤa.ħa.bat/: thi
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
